goal: Atomic historical claims (granular claim assertion with support/refute/uncertain source relation, explicit epistemic status)
summary: Implemented atomic historical claim granularity, decomposition, compound claim rejection, source relation links (supports vs contradicts), epistemic certainty tracking, and AI tutor atomic citation synthesis. Multi-sentence monolithic paragraphs cannot hide false or disputed statements behind a single citation. A contradicted or disputed claim cannot be masked as verified (negative abuse tested). Attaching a contradicting source immediately demotes an expert-verified claim to 'disputed'. AI Tutor synthesizes explanations with explicit atomic claim IDs and verification statuses.

invariants_enforced.atomic_statement_granularity: Claims must be discrete assertions, not multi-sentence or multi-paragraph statements. decompose_into_atomic_claims decomposes prose into discrete propositions, and validate_atomic_claim enforces single-proposition constraints.
invariants_enforced.compound_claim_rejection: reject_compound_claim_with_disputed_facts checks and rejects any compound statement that blends a verified claim with a disputed or contradicted assertion, preventing false statements from hiding behind an approved citation.
invariants_enforced.explicit_support_types: HistoricalSupportType controlled vocabulary enforced: supports, partially_supports, contextualizes, contradicts, mentions, primary_evidence_for, secondary_interpretation_of. Only 'supports' and 'primary_evidence_for' satisfy the factual verification invariant.
invariants_enforced.explicit_epistemic_certainty: HistoricalConfidence levels enforced: high, medium, low, disputed. Disputed claims are strictly rejected from transitioning to editor_reviewed or expert_verified.
invariants_enforced.contradiction_safeguards: claim_has_contradicting_source detects active contradiction bindings. Contradicted claims cannot be verified. Attaching a source with support_type='contradicts' immediately demotes expert_verified/editor_reviewed claims to 'disputed' and logs audit action 'contradict_demote'.
invariants_enforced.ai_tutor_atomic_citation: build_deterministic_answer synthesizes explanations explicitly citing each atomic claim ID and its verification status (e.g., [Khẳng định: <id> | Trạng thái: expert_verified]). Citations carry atomic claim_ids, verification_status, and support_type.

changes.description: Created domain module for atomic claim validation: decompose_into_atomic_claims, validate_atomic_claim, reject_compound_claim_with_disputed_facts, claim_has_contradicting_source, can_verify_atomic_claim, and synthesize_atomic_explanations.

Enforced atomic claim validation on create_claim and update_claim. Added contradiction check in _can_be_editor_reviewed and _can_be_expert_verified. In transition_claim_status, blocked transitioning contradicted or disputed claims to editor_reviewed / expert_verified. In attach_source_to_claim, added immediate demotion to 'disputed' when a contradicting source is attached to a verified claim.

Imported atomic claims domain validators. Updated build_deterministic_answer to synthesize explanations explicitly citing atomic claim IDs and verification statuses, and carry verification_status and support_type in citations.
Wrapped create_claim and update_claim calls in try-except ValueError returning HTTP 422 HISTORY_CLAIM_INVALID for compound claim rejection.

Comprehensive test suite verifying atomic claim decomposition, compound monolith rejection, hidden disputed fact rejection, negative abuse tests against contradicted/disputed claims, contradiction demotion, support type relations, and AI tutor atomic citation synthesis.

test_details.name: test_atomic_claim_decomposition
test_details.assertion: Verifies monolithic paragraph is decomposed into 3 discrete atomic assertions that each pass atomic validation.

test_details.name: test_atomic_claim_validation_rejects_compound_monolith
test_details.assertion: Asserts multi-sentence and newline-separated compound statements are rejected by validate_atomic_claim and return HTTP 422 on admin API.

test_details.name: test_reject_compound_claim_hiding_disputed_facts
test_details.assertion: Negative abuse test: Asserts compound statement blending a verified fact with a disputed assertion is rejected by reject_compound_claim_with_disputed_facts.

test_details.name: test_negative_abuse_cannot_mask_contradicted_claim_as_verified
test_details.assertion: Negative abuse test: A claim with a contradicting source cannot be verified as editor_reviewed or expert_verified (service raises ValueError, API returns 422).

test_details.name: test_negative_abuse_cannot_mask_disputed_confidence_as_verified
test_details.assertion: Negative abuse test: A claim with confidence='disputed' cannot be approved or verified (service raises ValueError, API returns 422).

test_details.name: test_attaching_contradicting_source_demotes_verified_claim
test_details.assertion: Asserts attaching a source with support_type='contradicts' immediately demotes an expert_verified claim to 'disputed' and writes an audit log.

test_details.name: test_source_relation_links_supports_vs_contradicts
test_details.assertion: Verifies HistoricalSupportType enum, ensures only 'supports' and 'primary_evidence_for' satisfy the factual verification invariant, while 'contextualizes' or 'mentions' does not.

test_details.name: test_ai_tutor_cites_atomic_claim_ids_and_verification_status
test_details.assertion: Asserts AI tutor answers cite specific atomic claim IDs and their verification status in answer_markdown and citations payload with active grounding metrics.
